note: Derived from the owner's night references (Hopper's Nighthawks mood, diner neon, elevated tracks, brownstones, lit windows, light trails, L.A. palms at blue hour, freeway trails, flag with city bokeh or starry sky, and stills from 'Drive' (2011): car interior at night, rearview mirror, sodium-lit roads, garage, city view from a window). Duplicates and one daylight image left out. Only the averaged embedding is stored, never the images. 'neighbors': one OpenCLIP vector per reference image (float16), for nearest-neighbour matching; not reversible to the images.
